title: Heat map
description: A grid of cells lights up in a wave from left to right; the stronger the colour, the higher the value, and the highest cells turn gold. After the wave a quiet scan keeps walking over the columns. The values are yours: a table, a week of hours, or the pixels of a picture. Plain SVG.

props.values: your numbers: rows of numbers [[..], [..]], or one flat list with "cols"
props.cols: cells per row when values is one flat list
props.numbers: true = print each value in its cell
props.hi: [row, column] of one cell to ring (counted from 0)
props.stage: ground colour: a name from STAGE, any colour, or none
